tasks.title: Plant Communication
paras: The discovery that plants use communication has changed our understanding of plant behavior and ecology. Traditionally, plants were considered passive organisms,reacting to environmental changes rather than actively engaging with their surroundings. However, studies have shown that plants can send chemical signals through the soil. These signals, often carried by root exudates (substances released by the plants' roots into the soil), can inform neighboring plants about threats like plant-eating animals or disease-causing agents. For instance, when a corn plant is attacked by caterpillars, it can release specific chemicals that warn nearby corn plants. In response, the neighboring corn plants may release a chemical known as MBOA into their tissues, which makes them less palatable to the caterpillars. Plants also use electrical signals to respond rapidly to environmental changes. These signals travel through the plant, allowing it to adjust resource allocation. Some plants can even detect the presence of other plants through their roots. This allows them to alter their growth patterns to avoid direct competition. Despite these discoveries, the study of plant communication is still in its infancy. Researchers are continuously uncovering new ways that plants interact with each other and their environment.

questions.stem: According to the passage,there used to be a mistaken view that plants

options.B: released root exudates only in small amounts
options.C: were not significantly affected by ecological factors
options.D: did not actively interact with other plants

questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型：细节题 原文定位：Traditionally, plants were considered passive organisms, reacting to environmental changes rather than actively engaging with their surroundings. 正确答案分析：文中明确说明，过去人们错误认为植物是被动的，不会主动与周围环境 / 其他植物互动，只是被动反应。 选项分析： (A) often changed their behavior 经常改变行为 —— 错误。传统观点认为植物被动、不主动改变行为。 (B) released root exudates only in small amounts 只释放少量根系分泌物 —— 错误。文中未提数量，传统观点甚至不知道植物会释放信号。 (C) were not significantly affected by ecological factors 不受生态因素显著影响 —— 错误。传统观点承认植物对环境变化有反应，只是不主动互动。 (D) did not actively interact with other plants 不主动与其他植物互动 —— 正确。对应 passively reacting rather than actively engaging。

questions.stem: According to the passage,corn plants may release MBOA into their tissues in response to

options.C: human activities that affect the environment
options.D: root exudates produced by other corn plants

questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型：细节题 原文定位：When a corn plant is attacked… release specific chemicals (root exudates) that warn nearby corn plants. In response… neighboring corn plants may release MBOA. 正确答案分析：被攻击的玉米通过根系分泌物发出警告，邻近玉米收到信号后才释放 MBOA。 选项分析： (A) harmful chemicals released by caterpillars 毛虫释放的有害化学物质 —— 错误。MBOA 是玉米自己释放的，不是对毛虫化学物的直接反应。 (B) electrical signals in the soil 土壤中的电信号 —— 错误。电信号是植物自身内部使用，此处是化学信号。 (C) human activities 人类活动 —— 错误。文中完全未提及人类活动。 (D) root exudates produced by other corn plants 其他玉米产生的根系分泌物 —— 正确。邻近玉米收到警告化学信号后释放 MBOA。

questions.stem: What can be inferred to be the purpose of electrical signals

options.A: To attract beneficial animals to the plants
options.B: To prevent attack by caterpillars on the plants
options.C: To help the plants make the best use of available resources
options.D: To communicate with other plants across long distances

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：推理题 原文定位：Plants also use electrical signals… allowing it to adjust resource allocation. 正确答案分析：电信号让植物调整资源分配，也就是最优利用资源。 选项分析： (A) attract beneficial animals 吸引有益动物 —— 错误。文中未提吸引动物。 (B) prevent attack by caterpillars 防止毛虫攻击 —— 错误。防止虫害是化学信号（MBOA）的功能，不是电信号。 (C) To help the plants make the best use of available resources 帮助植物最佳利用现有资源 —— 正确。对应 adjust resource allocation。 (D) communicate with other plants over long distances 远距离交流 —— 错误。电信号是植物体内快速传递，不是与其他植物交流。

questions.stem: Knowledge about the presence of other plants can help a plant to

options.A: change its growth in a way that reduces competition
options.B: prevent major damage to its roots
options.D: determine which chemicals to release into the soil

questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：细节题 原文定位：Some plants can even detect the presence of other plants… alter their growth patterns to avoid direct competition. 正确答案分析：植物侦测到其他植物存在后，改变生长模式以避免竞争。 选项分析： (A) change its growth in a way that reduces competition 改变生长以减少竞争 —— 正确。对应 alter growth patterns to avoid competition。 (B) prevent major damage to its roots 防止根部严重受损 —— 错误。文中未提根部损伤。 (C) identify additional resources 识别额外资源 —— 错误。重点是避开竞争，不是寻找更多资源。 (D) determine which chemicals to release 决定释放哪种化学物质 —— 错误。这是面对威胁时的反应，不是侦测其他植物时的作用。

questions.stem: The phrase"still in its infancy"in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型：词汇题 原文定位：Despite these discoveries, the study of plant communication is still in its infancy. 正确答案分析：in one’s infancy 是固定搭配，表示处于早期、起步阶段、尚未成熟。 选项分析： (A) highly controversial 极具争议 —— 错误。文中无争议含义。 (B) in a difficult period 处于困难时期 —— 错误。无困难含义。 (C) looking for funding 寻求资金 —— 错误。无关。 (D) at an early stage 处于早期阶段 —— 正确。完全对应固定短语含义。
